name: Windows Update triage and conservative repair
packageArguments: Optional string values encoded as base64 JSON: {"Mode":"Report","ResetCache":"false","RepairImage":"false","Notify":"true","Scan":"false","ScanTimeoutSeconds":"120","NativeTimeoutSeconds":"1200"}. Mode Report (passive default) or Repair. Booleans exactly true/false. Timeouts 10-3600 seconds. Report writes durable local evidence but performs no online scan unless Scan=true. Repair explicitly enables disabled allowlisted Windows Update services and verifies with bounded WUA search. ResetCache optionally renames SoftwareDistribution/catroot2 to unique preserved backups; regenerated datastore can lose displayed update history. RepairImage optionally runs DISM RestoreHealth then SFC; servicing is never killed on timeout and persistent marker blocks future maintenance pending manual reconciliation. No policy deletion, management takeover, safeguard bypass, upgrade or reboot. Exit 0 reported/repaired, 1 failed/partial, 2 deferred (never a reboot instruction). Reports under ProgramData/RelianMaintenance/Update; SYSTEM/Administrators only. Lifecycle dates limited to verified Windows 11 Professional 22H2/23H2; other releases unknown. Empty scan results do not establish OS currency or feature-upgrade availability. UI requires staged sibling PSAppDeployToolkit 4.1.8; diagnostics continue if no user/UI unavailable. Recent update-event evidence runs in a disposable read-only child with a 15-second observation deadline and servicing-transition cancellation; timeouts/omissions are explicit. Existing owned evidence directories must have trusted ownership and modification ACLs; unrelated Relian ACLs are not changed. Shared native markers live at ProgramData/RelianMaintenance/native-active.json; legacy Relian/Maintenance markers remain read-only guards. Native servicing stdout/stderr use child-owned file handles independent of the launcher lifetime.
